questions.q: Which snack gives you long-lasting energy?
questions.note: Fruit plus protein is a power-team for steady energy.

questions.q: Which color should join your plate next?
questions.note: Different colors often bring different helpful nutrients.

questions.q: What is the best everyday drink?
questions.note: Water hydrates your body and brain so you can run and think fast.

questions.q: Which nutrient in milk and yogurt helps build strong bones and teeth?
questions.note: Calcium teams up with Vitamin D to make your bones and teeth super strong!

questions.q: What superpower do orange veggies like carrots and sweet potatoes have?
questions.note: Orange veggies are rich in beta-carotene (Vitamin A), which helps your eyes see clearly!

questions.q: Why are whole grains like oatmeal and brown rice great for breakfast?
questions.note: Whole grains have fiber and B-vitamins that fuel your brain all morning long!

miniChallenge.title: Rainbow Kitchen Quest
miniChallenge.description: Find three different food colors in your kitchen or meal today and check them off!

didYouKnow.title: Did you know?
didYouKnow.fact: Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not botanically berries!
